prompt:
Use case: logo-brand.
Asset type: one original square painted app icon for Watchtower, the private control-centre companion app overseeing a family of World of Warcraft addons.
Input images: the three supplied local images are STYLE REFERENCES ONLY, showing this family's existing painted fantasy inventory icons. Match their hand-painted rendering, rich dark navy backdrop, sculpted warm gold, chunky forms and small-size clarity. Create a completely new tower subject, do not include their books, keys or shields.
Primary request: a single stout miniature fantasy stone watchtower with a large warm amber signal beacon in its crown. The tower is carved from substantial blue-grey slate masonry with a wide projecting crenellated lookout gallery, chunky aged golden-bronze trim along the battlements and gallery, and a broad stable polygonal stone foot. A prominent bright golden flame burns within a simple heavy brass lantern cage rising from the open crown, clearly the focal point, like the watch kept over a city through the night. Two tall arched openings directly under the gallery glow warmly from within. Use just a few large masonry courses, strong recognisable architectural shapes and generous bevels, with gold fittings catching warm yellow-gold highlights and deep burnt-orange shadow. A restrained cool blue rim separates the lower stone silhouette from the dark background. Slight three-quarter view shows the front and one side. The tower feels like a substantial enchanted inventory item from Azeroth, not a distant building in a landscape, a lighthouse photograph or a modern control dashboard.
Style/medium: richly hand-painted Warcraft-like fantasy inventory illustration, bold angular brushstrokes visible across stone and metal, thick textured paint, dramatic warm highlights, deep saturated shadows, slightly exaggerated chunky proportions. Match the supplied examples' cohesive illustrator's hand. Keep a strong compact silhouette and simplified large features readable at 32-64 pixels.
Composition/backdrop: one centred hero object occupies around 82-86% of the square, completely visible with a narrow dark breathing margin. Full-bleed opaque midnight-navy square, restrained painterly cobalt vignette close behind the tower, quiet near-black corners. The flame's warm glow is local and controlled. No outer frame or rounded app tile.
Constraints: one finished square icon only. No text, letters, initials, numbers, writing, runes, wordmark, watermark, mockup or logo sheet. No human figures, weapons, shields, books, keys, faction crests, flags, terrain, landscape or sky scene. No status-light dots, interface panels or charts. No photorealism, flat vector art, smooth glossy 3D rendering, fine filigree, scattered sparkles or oversized magical aura.
